text: This candidate received an overall score of 0.2454 for the Senior Software Engineer position. Their strongest evidence includes experience with "Python", "React", and "AWS". Key gaps include a lack of experience with vue.js and node.js, as well as having only 1.5 years of experience compared to the implied 4-year requirement. The application has been escalated for further review despite the missing must-have skills and low overall fit.
